test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When x is added to each of 26, 40, 22 and 34, then the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. Then, if 4x : y :: y : (7x-6), and y > 0, what is the value of y?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For numbers **a, b, c, d** to be in proportion after adding **x**: **x = (ad − bc) ÷ ((a + d) − (b + c))**.

Here a = 26, b = 40, c = 22, d = 34.

x = (26 × 34 − 40 × 22) ÷ ((26 + 34) − (40 + 22)) = (884 − 880) ÷ (60 − 62) = 4 ÷ (−2) = −2.

Mean proportional **y² = 4x × (7x − 6)** ⇒ y² = 4(−2) × (7(−2) − 6) = −8 × (−20) = 160. (Check values: 26−2=24, 40−2=38, 22−2=20, 34−2=32. 24/38 ≠ 20/32).

Correcting calculation: x = (bc − ad) ÷ ((a+d) − (b+c)) = (880 − 884) ÷ (60 − 62) = −4 ÷ −2 = 2. **x = 2**. Then y² = 4(2) × (7(2) − 6) = 8 × 8 = 64 ⇒ **y = 8**.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41bcfdfabef2b446168c41c2e7b620b93389c0ec7afe279fb5943b9042152bf5.png] 

**Given:** Numbers 26, 40, 22, 34. Added value is x. Resulting numbers are in **proportion**.

**Formula:** (a+x)/(b+x) = (c+x)/(d+x)

⇒ (26 + x) × (34 + x) = (22 + x) × (40 + x)

⇒ 884 + 26x + 34x + x² = 880 + 22x + 40x + x²

⇒ 884 + 60x = 880 + 62x

⇒ 62x − 60x = 884 − 880

⇒ 2x = 4 ⇒ **x = 2**

⇒ Given 4x : y :: y : (7x − 6)

⇒ y² = 4x × (7x − 6)

⇒ y² = 4(2) × (7 × 2 − 6)

⇒ y² = 8 × (14 − 6)

⇒ y² = 8 × 8 = 64

⇒ y = √64 = 8 (as y > 0)

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(ab). It is also written as a : b :: b : c where b² = ac.

Proportion Rule

For four numbers a, b, c, d to be in proportion, the product of extremes must equal the product of means (ad = bc).

Third Proportional

If a, b, c are in continued proportion, then c is the third proportional to a and b, calculated as c = b² ÷ a.</p
